svg.title: Toolmaker — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as toolmaker, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A C-frame micrometer has an upper anvil, lower spindle and thimble, with a narrow part in the measuring gap. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, an oval face and round glasses.
